objective: Run a five-target public-synthetic arbitrary-target degree-23 index-calculus panel and compare every exact target with signed-Frobenius/negation quotient Pollard rho without constructing target scalar labels.

targets.construction: domain-separated BLAKE3 x/sign draw, exact uniform-affine decoding, public cofactor projection, reject infinity and duplicates

factor_base.log_learning_boundary: Factor-base orbit logs and target scalar are learned only from collected relation rows and modular linear algebra.

required_retained_payloads: one record for every relation candidate, including refuted, Unknown, invalid, and direct-skipped outcomes
every admitted relation row with coefficients and orbit-column entries
matrix dimensions, rank history, terminal rank, and modular solve attempts, including an incomplete max-trial return
exact progress events from factor-base setup through point verification

rho.algorithm: same-target signed-Frobenius/negation quotient r-adding Pollard rho
required_operation_ledger: setup scalar multiplications and group additions
partition hashes, collisions, and failed collisions

execution.task_order: one fresh locked build; two public discovery processes; one target-panel process; then five IC/rho pairs in target order

accounting.peak_rss_scope: maximum process high-water mark; not summed or simultaneous aggregate parallel memory
accounting.timing_stage_overlap: forbidden; rho walk timing closes before candidate verification begins
required_index_calculus_stages: every relation candidate and every capped Unknown
relation matrix construction and rank checks

ratios.online: sum(IC process total_core_seconds) / sum(rho process total_core_seconds)
ratios.setup_charged: (public discovery process total_core_seconds + sum(IC process total_core_seconds)) / sum(rho process total_core_seconds)
ratios.whole_driver: reported separately and never divided into a synthetic algorithm ratio

row_acceptance.ic_complete: recovered scalar exists, [d]G equals the public target, direct relation is false, invalid models are zero, and retained attempts/matrix/rank/progress are internally complete
row_acceptance.rho_complete: recovered scalar exists, [d]G equals the same public target, and the operation ledger balances

panel_acceptance.project_verifier_reconstruction: Rebuild the exact task prefix, intents, commands, watchdogs, environments, inputs, raw metrics, receipts, parsed results, rows, resources, ratios, and panel state from sealed files.

forbidden_inference: An incomplete IC or rho row is evidence against the algorithm or target.
Recovered target scalars or factor-base logs were supplied as labels.
One five-target n=23 panel establishes an asymptotic scaling law.
A component or best-of-run ratio is a whole-process crossover.
Project-authored verification is independent external reproduction or novelty review.
This panel establishes a cryptographic-size attack, deployed-key result, or Koblitz index-calculus SOTA.
claim_boundary: A complete panel would measure five public-synthetic scalar-hidden degree-23 IC and matched signed-Frobenius rho rows with full retained relation and operation evidence. It cannot by itself establish asymptotic crossover, cryptographic-size security impact, novelty, external reproduction, or SOTA.
